name: Interlock/InTr Evidence Custody
purpose: Package and hand off the exact hash-linked admission, transition, egress, return, and application-disposition evidence from one governed Interlock/InTr exchange to the canonical evidence/custody surface without converting recording or reconstruction into transition authority.
trigger: a governed Interlock/InTr exchange has produced evidence that must survive the invocation
scope: one completed, denied, failed, or partial governed exchange evidence set
reuse_instructions: Use Master Records or the applicable canonical custody/reconstruction surface for durable observed reality. Preserve denied, failed, partial, and successful outcomes distinctly. Do not rewrite application or transition state merely because evidence was recorded or reconstructed.
